title: DEQ equilibrium Mirror coordinate
hypothesis: A role-conditioned Mirror input view inside a contractive shared fixed-point operator recovers unseen equilibrium functions with fewer bytes than per-role operators; solver residual/iterations and direct controls are charged.
physical_object: One 8D contractive equilibrium operator with shared input/output maps
mirror_coordinate: Two role-specific Givens angles applied to shared input features before fixed-point iteration
logical_multiplicity: Two task-role equilibrium functions, evaluated across heldout input distributions
controls: generic direct role-angle code inside equilibrium operator
success_gate: All fresh worlds: Mirror output NRMSE <=1e-4, converged residual <=1e-7, <=50% bytes of independent operators; Mirror-specific advantage >=10% bytes or solver MACs over direct/rank2 at matched quality.
failure_gate: Direct angle control exactly aliases Mirror, instability/nonconvergence, or frozen quality/storage gate missed.
boundaries: Synthetic contractive fixed-point mechanism only; no trained DEQ/DEQ Transformer, natural task, GPU, or capacity claim.
Teacher inserts a Givens role view inside the shared operator, favorable to Mirror.
compute_contract: A1 active MAC proxy includes x-to-hidden projection, each fixed-point iteration, final output projection and view transform; all stored solver/role/basis settings are decoded.
